fix(postgres): fence cancelled dispatch progression

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-43
  description: |-
    Lock the owning Attempt before normal dispatch creation, claim acquisition, and send-permit issuance. Reject progression when durable cancellation authority is present so restarted workers cannot resume prepared or running dispatches after cancel-first wins.
    
    Add PostgreSQL acceptance coverage for cancellation before dispatch creation and restarted prepared/running dispatch progression.
